hypothesis: The reservation step serializes stock reservation with Modules.LOCKING, which defaults to the in-memory provider. That lock lives in each Medusa process's memory, so two servers sharing one database do not exclude each other. Two carts each wanting the single SOLO unit, completed on different servers at the same time, could both pass the availability check and both reserve it, giving an oversell and a failed no_oversell check.
